Read-only admin adjustments page: adjustment list and detail (adminListAdjustments, adminGetAdjustment) and the bad-debt write-off candidates tab (adminListBadDebtWriteoffs). No write entry (create and review belong to F1-08cb / ce / cc / cd). Amounts only through @couli/money; types, subjects and statuses from the admin dictionary, the contra subject shown with its platform. The frozen dashboard cases [AC-F1-14a-MENU#3]/[#4] already land on /content since F1-08caa (#163, D10-1724); no frozen case is modified here. Codex is out of quota until 2026-11-20 (D10-1604), so per ops/approvals.yaml #36 the rule tests were written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, fresh context): 31 tests; another independent Claude spec-test r1 pass with two S2. Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context); couli-ci --browser run 1 green before rebase; verify:fast before rebase was red only in MENU#3/#4 because the worktree predated #163, rerun by the required CI checks after rebase. Written by hand.
